title: My profile
hint: Your citizen identity as the server knows it.
notLoggedInText: Open this panel from the game to see your profile, your pending votes and, if you are an administrator, the administration area.
pendingVotesHint: Ongoing elections you have not voted in yet.
nothingToVoteText: You are up to date on all ongoing elections.
adminRightsText: The administration area gives access to logs, moderation, the command console and exports. Every sensitive action asks for confirmation.
